CREATE function CDN.KOL_AdresyDoWydania( @p_ope int, @p_twr int, @p_tpa int, @p_cck int, @p_cecha varchar(20), @p_ean varchar(40), @p_data int, @p_dst int, @p_mag int, @p_ilosc decimal(11,4), @p_jlog int ) returns @adresy2 table(adres varchar(25),mga_id int, ilosc decimal(15,6), tzm_jednostkalog int,tpaid int) AS BEGIN
if @p_tpa<0 set @p_tpa=null if @p_data<0 set @p_data=null if @p_dst<0 set @p_dst=null if @p_jlog<0 set @p_jlog=null declare @adresy table(adres varchar(25),mga_id int, ilosc decimal(15,6), tzm_jednostkalog int,tpaid int)
insert into @adresy select isnull(cdn.pobierzmagadres(TZM_MgAId),'Nieznane') adres, TZM_MgAId MgA_Id, sum(TZM_Ilosc) Ilosc, TZM_JednostkaLog,tpa_id from CDN.TwrPartie inner join CDN.TwrKarty on Twr_GIDNumer=TPA_TwrNumer inner join CDN.TwrZasobyMag on TZM_TPAId=TPA_Id and TZM_MagNumer=@p_mag left outer join CDN.MagAdresy A on A.MgA_Id=TZM_MgAId --MSm begin --left outer join CDN.InwNag on InN_MagNumer=@p_mag and InN_TStampZam=0 left outer join CDN.InwMag on InM_MagNumer=@p_mag left outer join CDN.InwNag on InN_Id=InM_InNId and InN_TStampZam=0 --MSm end left outer join CDN.InwArk on InA_MgOId=A.MgA_MgOId and InA_InNId=InN_Id left outer join CDN.MagAdresy O on O.MgA_Id=InA_MgAIdOd left outer join CDN.MagAdresy D on D.MgA_Id=InA_MgAIdDo and A.MgA_Segment1+A.MgA_Segment2+A.MgA_Segment3+A.MgA_Segment4 between O.MgA_Segment1+O.MgA_Segment2+O.MgA_Segment3+O.MgA_Segment4 and D.MgA_Segment1+D.MgA_Segment2+D.MgA_Segment3+D.MgA_Segment4 left outer join CDN.MagParAdr on MPA_Id=A.MgA_MPAId where TPA_TwrNumer=@p_twr and TZM_JednostkaLog=isnull(@p_jlog,TZM_JednostkaLog) and D.MgA_Id is null group by TPA_Id, TPA_CCKNumer, TPA_Cecha, TPA_Ean, TPA_DataW, TPA_DstNumer, Twr_PartiaDostawa, TZM_MgAId, TZM_JednostkaLog, MPA_PriorytetP order by MPA_PriorytetP, -- priorytet case when TPA_Id=@p_tpa then 0 when TPA_CCKNumer=@p_cck and TPA_Cecha=@p_cecha and TPA_Ean=isnull(@p_ean,TPA_Ean) and TPA_DataW=isnull(@p_data,TPA_DataW) and (TPA_DstNumer=isnull(@p_dst,TPA_DstNumer) or Twr_PartiaDostawa=0) then 1 else 2 end, -- dobra partia lub jej cechy case when sum(TZM_Ilosc)<=@p_ilosc then 0 else sum(TZM_Ilosc) end -- można zwolnić do końca lub jak najmniejsze
insert into @adresy2 select * from @adresy where tpaid=@p_tpa or @p_tpa is null delete from @adresy insert into @adresy select distinct adres,mga_id,0,0,0 from @adresy2 delete from @adresy2 insert into @adresy2 select * from @adresy
return
END
